items.quote: Jacob sware by the fear of his father Isaac
items.claim: Jacob swore an oath invoking the fear of his father Isaac
items.object: by the fear of his father Isaac

items.quote: The God of Abraham, and the God of Nahor, the God of their father, judge betwixt us
items.claim: An invocation calling upon the God of Abraham and Nahor to judge between two parties
items.actor: The God of Abraham, and the God of Nahor
